items.title: Hail to the Squash King
items.summary: Hilma af Klint painting shatters records, new Edward Said documentary, the politics of pigment, and how should we memorialize the Trump era?

items.title: Is GTA VI the Art Miami Deserves?
items.summary: Miami-based artists Leo Castañeda and misael soto join Hyperallergic in a conversation about the tensions of a game that portrays a changing city locked in time.

items.title: A Sprawling Exhibition of Latin American Art and Fashion Is Coming to NYC
items.summary: Twenty artists and designers across the Americas will be featured in "Malvestir" at MoMA PS1 this spring, probing the historical and contemporary resonances of Latin American dress.

items.title: In a Midtown Office, Artists Sift Through the Junkspace of Capitalism
items.summary: An intergenerational group of artists confronts technology as both a pathogen and a cure for today’s cultural ailments in the husk of an office at 260 Madison.
